conditional_correctness: Any stated interval must identify compatible source-field endpoints; five minutes is observation-to-sample, four is record-to-sample.
An occurrence interval cannot be inferred by merging first_observed and record_written.
Any actual-onset assertion must be supported; first_observed alone does not establish onset.
Ordering observations does not establish ordering of real fault onsets; a cumulative counter is not a trend.
Omitting optional arithmetic cannot conceal a wrong stated time, false causation, denied reset, missing requested advice or source violation.
Missing explicit uncertainty is a genuine omission if onset is requested or needed to qualify an otherwise misleading conclusion.
